rationale: Despite elevated relative volume (6.07x) following earnings, the current bid-ask spread is prohibitively wide at $0.45 (66.5 bps), which equates to nearly half of the 5-minute ATR ($0.99) and destroys intraday reward-to-risk mechanics.
